title: North Atlantic right whale population drops to 382, scientists warn of extinction risk
digest: North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium released annual data on November 17, 2026, showing the species' population fell 2% to 382 individuals. The decline is attributed to climate-driven food chain shifts, historical overfishing, and increased vessel collisions (NOAA records 9-year injury/death peak). Current population includes only 73 breeding females, raising concerns about reproductive viability. Oceana, a conservation group, opposes delaying the 2035 marine protection policy, citing the data as evidence for urgent risk mitigation.

representative.summary: 某研究团队发布数据显示，北大西洋露脊鲸种群数量较去年下降2%，降至382头。科学家指出海洋变暖导致食物链迁移，叠加捕捞和船舶碰撞威胁，种群恢复困难。NOAA数据显示近九年该物种受伤死亡数量创纪录，目前仅存73头育龄雌鲸，种群再生面临挑战。环保组织Oceana反对推迟2035年新保护政策，认为最新数据凸显亟需减少人为威胁。
